design_status: GO at round 15 (0C/0H/0I) + ERRATUM 1 landed under six binding obligations (C06_FALSIFIER_ERRATUM1_REVIEW.md §5) + CODE-R1 §8 correction + ERRATUM 2 landed under the round-7 obligations (C06_FALSIFIER_ERRATUM2_REVIEW_R7.md). v15 remains on disk unmodified at 75e3aa84a39f3c276be8b5b7fb1271e83c0c2e7e3b0ad0480b47465a81408228; V15E1 at 8cde58aade0d04873f5313a89d6f321c59423e602a85fd88d6505593b0d58f7d.

erratum_1.defect: §5.4 pre-registered a per-item accuracy decomposition as THE bootstrap statistic while S4 spans holm_metrics=[accuracy,macro_f1] and §5.5 counts both; the 46 macro-F1 hypotheses per dataset had no statistic.
erratum_1.repair: accuracy leg RETAINED VERBATIM; a macro-F1 bullet ADDED using C01's recompute-per-resample form via mechfix_ops.macro_f1, seed mean inside.
erratum_1.why_retained: S4's `lower > 0` and zero-adverse-count predicates are the only ulp-sensitive predicates in the design; 38.8% of near-identical arm pairs get a different one_sided_raw_p under the two forms and 1.2% flip `lower > 0`.
erratum_1.tie_direction: mechfix_ops can only REMOVE draws from S4's adverse count, never add (19.3% of mathematically-tied draws) -> S4 easier -> SURVIVE easier -> CLOSE harder -> conservative under §4; disclosed at §5.9 item 10.

execution.process_order: 1 gate-sha driver leg -> 66 mints -> 6 fidelity -> 1 arena

c01_source.note: §3.7 second block: these constants are READ from the sha-gated C01 config and asserted equal, never recomputed (§13.1 item 5b).

population_derived_constants._verb: COMPUTED from the arena at run time and asserted equal to these frozen values by GATE-POP; never read as inputs (§3.7 first block, §13.1 item 5a).

arena.fold_contract: StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=0) over the full train split
arena.mask_convention: zero_mask is ALWAYS an explicit boolean array, never None (§3.7)

arms.note: avg_score is a C01 gain_control, hence a comparator for BOTH real arms (§3.5).

decision_rule.S6_reference: select_strongest_ordinary_control over decision.gain_controls, within each (dataset, lineage) cell (D-1, §5.2.1)
decision_rule.S7_statistic: head-space one-block d_i = ||l2(h_ow_i) - l2(h_std_i)||, per item under the head that scored it

verdict_rules.1: SURVIVE if any lineage that passed its per-lineage gates clears S1-S7 on both datasets
verdict_rules.2: CLOSE if BOTH lineages passed their per-lineage gates and neither clears

decision_rule.dataset_axis_of_drop: a lineage failing a per-lineage gate on ANY dataset is dropped on BOTH (§5.6)

GATE-ORBITDISP.granularity: per fold, all 60 head cells, all 13 arms
GATE-ORBITDISP.reduction: mean accumulated in float64 over the float32 keys

GATE-ZEROOP.aggregation: per (dataset, seed, lineage), pooling the five folds
GATE-ZEROOP.ranking: union of the two arms' top-21 sets
GATE-ZEROOP.collapse: worst case over orderings, computed ANALYTICALLY

GATE-FLOOR.scope: Head-N through the shared driver, native keys, full n; anchors the driver, hence global
